verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that functions are written in TypeScript, Python, or Go using an official SDK. A versioned TypeScript SDK reference (v4) includes a testing library, and the SDK ecosystem adds an ESLint plugin, step.ai.wrap for AI SDKs, and the AgentKit framework. Community users independently praise the SDK developer experience, though one finds the TypeScript execution model initially unintuitive. Missing for 10: evidence of comparably deep Python and Go SDK references, and hands-on corroboration that names a specific SDK.
